scripts.name: Start Proxy
scripts.command: uv run --no-sync --env-file .env bash -o pipefail -c 'python litellm/proxy/proxy_cli.py --config "${CONFIG_FILE_PATH:-litellm/proxy/dev_config.yaml}" --host 127.0.0.1 --num_workers 2 --detailed_debug --reload --use_v2_migration_resolver 2>&1 | tee litellm.log'
